title: Former Adidas manager wins $1.23m after jury finds racially hostile work environment
summary_full: In a landmark ruling, an Oregon jury has held Adidas America accountable for fostering a racially hostile work environment affecting April Burton. Despite her initial claim for over $16 million, the jury awarded her only $1.23 million in punitive damages. Claims of wrongful termination and racial discrimination were rejected, while Adidas defended itself, citing concerns about Burton's workplace conduct, and reaffirmed its commitment to a diverse and inclusive culture.
